name: totalmix
description: Control an RME TotalMix FX mixer via OSC: levels, mute, solo, pan, routing, submixes, headphone mixes, EQ, dynamics, monitoring. Bundles the totalmix MCP server.

totalmix_host.title: TotalMix host
totalmix_host.description: IP address of the machine running TotalMix FX. Use 127.0.0.1 if TotalMix runs on this same computer. (totalmix-mcp-stdio only.)

totalmix_send_port.title: OSC send port (TotalMix In Port)
totalmix_send_port.description: Port TotalMix listens on for incoming OSC. Matches the In Port in TotalMix Options > OSC. (totalmix-mcp-stdio only.)

totalmix_listen_port.title: OSC listen port (TotalMix Out Port)
totalmix_listen_port.description: Port the local server listens on for OSC status from TotalMix. Matches the Out Port in TotalMix Options > OSC. (totalmix-mcp-stdio only.)

http_url.title: HTTP daemon URL
http_url.description: MCP endpoint of a running totalmix-mcp HTTP daemon, e.g. https://<host>:8765/mcp. Only used by the totalmix-mcp-http connector; ignore it if you only use the local stdio server.

http_token.title: HTTP daemon bearer token
http_token.description: The daemon's MCP_AUTH_TOKEN. Only used by the totalmix-mcp-http connector.
